The method `ArrayUtils.addAll` from Apache Commons Lang3 library is overloaded and can handle different types of arrays. It seems like there was an issue when trying to add an `Integer` array and a `Long` array using the `addAll` method. The failure occurred when trying to add a `Long` array into an `Integer` array, leading to an `IllegalArgumentException`.

Based on the failing test case and the bug report, it is evident that the `ArrayUtils.addAll` method does not handle mixed types of arrays well. Specifically, in this case, adding a `Long` array into an `Integer` array resulted in an `IllegalArgumentException`.

To address this issue, the `ArrayUtils.addAll` method should be enhanced to handle mixed array types more effectively, possibly by performing type checks or conversions to ensure compatibility when combining arrays of different types.
